interventions.detail: Used a Python 3.10 uv venv; PaddlePaddle 2.4-2.6 has no wheels for the system Python 3.12
Installed CPU paddlepaddle==2.6.2 from PyPI instead of the documented paddlepaddle-gpu==2.4.2 from the Tsinghua mirror
Pinned numpy<2 for compatibility with paddle 2.6 and opencv-python<=4.6.0
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0 (opencv runtime) and unzip
Pre-downloaded the PP_STDCNet2 pretrained backbone into ~/.paddleseg/pretrained_model so it is not fetched at train time
